youtube_description:
An example problem for the differential form of the conservation of mass as applied to fluid flow.

An incompressible flow has the velocity components: 
𝑢=𝑥^3+2*𝑧^2 
𝑤=𝑦^3−2*𝑦*z
Determine the most general form of 𝑣 (the y component of v) which satisfies the 
conservation of mass.

PDF of solution: https://sdsu.box.com/s/t0p8kvmaqa48c9d86eylklyh6swenisz
